name: Polyneuropathy Associated with IgM Monoclonal Gammopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for IgM Monoclonal Gammopathy-Associated Polyneuropathy

criteria.description: Presence of IgM monoclonal gammopathy confirmed by serum protein electrophoresis and immunofixation
Symmetric distal sensory and motor neuropathy with predominant sensory ataxia and tremor
Nerve conduction studies showing demyelinating features consistent with polyneuropathy
Presence of anti-myelin-associated glycoprotein (MAG) antibodies in serum
Exclusion of other causes of polyneuropathy such as diabetes, vitamin deficiencies, or other paraproteinemias

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of IgM monoclonal gammopathy plus clinical and electrophysiological evidence of demyelinating polyneuropathy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Anti-MAG antibody positivity supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Impaired vibration sensation in the lower limbs

laboratory: Serum protein electrophoresis showing IgM monoclonal gammopathy
Presence of anti-MAG antibodies in serum
Elevated cerebrospinal fluid protein with normal cell count (albuminocytologic dissociation)
imaging: MRI of peripheral nerves may show nerve enlargement
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; sporadic or associated with monoclonal gammopathy
other: Nerve conduction studies showing demyelinating features with prolonged distal latencies and slowed conduction velocities
Nerve biopsy may show demyelination and onion bulb formations

distinguishingFeatures: IgM monoclonal gammopathy present but negative anti-MAG antibodies
Different clinical course and response to treatment
Predominantly motor involvement without sensory ataxia
Focal conduction block on nerve conduction studies

redFlags: Rapidly progressive weakness or respiratory failure
Severe autonomic dysfunction (e.g., syncope, bowel/bladder dysfunction)
Development of systemic symptoms suggesting malignant transformation (e.g., weight loss, night sweats)
references: Dalakas MC. IgM monoclonal gammopathy-associated neuropathies. Neurol Clin. 2013;31(2):495-507.
Nobile-Orazio E, et al. Diagnosis and treatment of IgM paraproteinemic neuropathies. Nat Rev Neurol. 2019;15(6):335-348.
Orphanet: Polyneuropathy associated with IgM monoclonal gammopathy (ORPHA:209004)
